description: Dedupe resolution clears duplicate risk only; it must not mark generated content as approved for active component publication.
A single-member public cluster may be marked dedupe-resolved when trust and privacy boundaries are public, but it still requires content review.
Multi-member clusters sharing a content hash should be routed to exact duplicate merge review instead of automatic publication.
Every dedupe resolution should emit a quality index row so review queues can find clusters by action, confidence, status, and member count.
Every dedupe resolution should emit a review ticket or content-review marker with reason and status.
Planning emits CSV, JSONL, and SQL only; actual psql execution remains a separate operator or worker step.
